title: Amount of a Self-Pay Ground Shipping Charge, PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Clause.** For the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, the ground charge is the schedule's ground shipping fee for the newest self-pay shipment that went out by ground and carries no shipping charge, unless the list value of its items reaches the schedule's free-shipping minimum, in which case nothing is owed. The charge booked is rounded to the cent half up.

## Definitions

- **The newest self-pay shipment that went out by ground:** the enrollment's self-pay item lines sharing the ship date of the newest self-pay item line that went out by ground. Every self-pay item line with that ship date belongs to the shipment.
- **Carries no shipping charge:** the enrollment has no shipping-charge line dated with that ship date.
- **List value of its items:** the units of each item on the shipment multiplied by that item's cash price, totalled.
- **Reaches:** is at or above the free-shipping minimum.

## Judgement table

| Shipping charge already dated with the ship date | List value against the free-shipping minimum | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| yes | — | none (already charged) |
| no | at or above | none (free) |
| no | below | the schedule's ground shipping fee |

## Worked example (hypothetical prices and figures)

A ground shipment of 4 filters at a hypothetical cash price of 2.50 and 1 headgear at 35.00 has a list value of 10.00 plus 35.00, which is 45.00. With a hypothetical free-shipping minimum of 75.00, 45.00 is below it, so the ground shipping fee is owed — with a hypothetical fee of 6.95, the charge is 6.95. A ground shipment with a list value of 75.00 reaches a 75.00 minimum and owes nothing.
